scope: Local static review of an independently versioned low-rate/high-load diagnostic. No capture or test run by reviewer; formal F 110-window tools remain frozen and unchanged.
verified: Default rate 200, sample observer and original loadgen SHA remain defaults. An alternative loadgen must be explicitly supplied and hash matched.
Cache prewarm remains a separate 1000-request UDP run at 200 queries/second, regardless of the main diagnostic rate.
Rate 0 is allowed only for UDP. Each nonzero-duration unpaced phase must be nonempty, scheduled=sent=correct, and have zero skips/wrong/timeout/transport errors.
Observer none creates no perf/strace instrument. It records parent stat endpoints and the actual successful warmup+measurement cohort count.
039de987 checks the fixed-grace child list is empty before reading cpu-after.stat, so waited-child ticks are incorporated before that endpoint.
Exact artifact/mapping identity checks, fixed 1 second grace and no-leftover-child rule remain in place.
interpretation_requirements: CPU delta must include parent user/system plus waited-child user/system and use the recorded SC_CLK_TCK. Keep raw endpoint ticks and their quantization explicit.
For rate0, normalize CPU/event counts by actual warmup+measurement successful operations; measurement throughput uses the 20-second measurement cohort separately.
The old analysis entry point pins C/E identities and 5000 operations and only supports stat/sample. It must not be silently reused for F/read-one rate-0/none outputs.
Defaults preserve workload parameters, not byte-identical historical instrumentation: the new driver adds CPU stat reads and has a new identity. Do not pool historical diagnostics.
The diagnostic is not deployment acceptance or evidence of physical-router gains.

resolved_issue.issue: Original feature commit read cpu-after before checking children, allowing a TCP reap between the two observations to undercount child CPU.
resolved_issue.resolution: 039de987 moves the no-child assertion before the final CPU read. Planned UDP has no service children, but the general endpoint now has the correct ordering.
